necessary_context.content: Connected simple undirected graph G=(V,E), with n nodes, each holding f_i:R^d→R. The objective is min_theta fbar(theta)=n^{-1} sum_i f_i(theta). Every f_i is alpha-strongly convex and beta-smooth, with 0<alpha<=beta and kappa_l=beta/alpha; the global condition number kappa_g is not substituted for kappa_l.
necessary_context.name: Objective and local regularity

necessary_context.applies_to: Implementation and resource interpretation of MSDA
necessary_context.content: W is a symmetric PSD n×n matrix with ker(W)=span(1); nonzero entries occur only on the diagonal or graph edges. lambda_1>=...>=lambda_n.
necessary_context.name: Gossip matrix and normalized eigengap

necessary_context.applies_to: Implementation and resource interpretation of MSDA
necessary_context.content: The selected Oracle is the exact local Fenchel-conjugate gradient; one parallel local gradient phase takes time 1, and one neighboring communication phase takes time tau. The warm-start, composite, and primal-gradient alternatives discussed in the source do not automatically inherit the same accounting.
necessary_context.locator: Main p.2 Section 2; p.6 computation discussion
necessary_context.name: Oracle and charging
